reports.title: A massive early leak outlined the S22 family
reports.summary: A report claimed major details for the Galaxy S22 family, including screen sizes, cameras and batteries, months before launch.

reports.title: Smaller displays and batteries were tipped for S22 and S22+
reports.summary: Notebookcheck reported leaked display, camera and battery specifications, including smaller panels and batteries for the non-Ultra models.

reports.title: S22 and S22+ renders showed a familiar design
reports.summary: XDA reported renders of the Galaxy S22 and S22+ with a familiar design direction and revised camera treatment.

reports.title: OnLeaks renders suggested a flatter camera bump
reports.summary: A separate report on OnLeaks renders described a flatter camera bump and styling reminiscent of the Galaxy S21 family.

reports.title: Dummy units for all three S22 models appeared
reports.summary: SamMobile reported leaked dummy units for the Galaxy S22, S22+ and S22 Ultra, giving enthusiasts a physical comparison before launch.
